reviews.original_owner: Original DX8Wrapper state setter and DX8MeshRenderer decal depth bias
reviews.behavior: The decal flush requests bias 8 then restores 0. Native SetRenderState forwards to Apply_DX8_Render_State; fog/ambient handlers do not handle ZBIAS and the native state switch falls through to a diagnostic and success without applying depth bias.
affected_scope: Native rigid/skinned decal rendering across all maps/modes reaching decal flush; actual per-map decals and physical appearance require S4 and runtime verification.
reviews.acceptance_open: Preserve original bias semantics and reset/state lifetime at native draw boundary; verify representative decals on Vita/PSTV. Source mapping evidence does not establish observed z-fighting.
